description: Une vallée japonaise enneigée de bassins turquoise, ryokan chaleureux, Fuji et lune.
identity: An impossible snowy Japanese onsen kingdom contrasting luminous cyan water with warm inhabited ryokan under Mount Fuji and a giant moon.
invariants: A natural foreground rotenburo carved into black volcanic stone.
Several realistic Japanese macaques but never a crowd.
Irregular cascading turquoise pools and small waterfalls form the leading line.
Dark wooden ryokan with warm windows occupy both valley sides among snow, steam, rock and red maples.
Monumental Mount Fuji and giant moon close the vertical 9:16 background.
variables: Winter, red-gold autumn or misty spring morning.
Moonlight, pink dawn, blue hour or rainy night.
Turquoise, emerald, opaline blue or mineral violet water.
Ryokan and steam density; macaques may cautiously become cranes, sika deer or no animal.
risks: Theme-park clutter from mixed Japanese symbols.
Oversized animals or perfectly symmetric artificial valley.
canonical_prompt:
Vertical 9:16 hyperrealistic cinematic photograph of an impossible Japanese onsen kingdom hidden within immense snow-covered volcanic mountains at blue hour, viewed from a high natural rocky ledge.

A beautiful foreground rotenburo is carved directly into black volcanic stone. Crystal-clear mineral water glows turquoise and sapphire. White steam reveals underwater rocks, mineral formations and drifting red maple leaves. A small group of realistic Japanese macaques relaxes naturally.

Beyond it, hundreds of natural hot springs descend through the valley in irregular organic terraces, connected by steaming waterfalls and mineral streams. Traditional dark wooden ryokan villages with snow-covered roofs, glowing shoji windows, balconies and open-air baths inhabit cliffs among ancient cedars and rock. Thousands of warm amber lights create intricate depth.

Hot waterfalls fall from cliffs into steam. Snowflakes cross warm beams. In the distance enormous Mount Fuji rises above clouds and a gigantic pale moon. The asymmetric foreground pool leads toward turquoise basins, ryokan, Fuji and moon. Hyperrealistic fantasy travel photography, believable water and steam, intricate wood and stone, deep atmosphere, luminous HDR, controlled bloom, hyper HD 8K finish.

No dragon, no kitsune, no pagoda, no torii tunnel, no cherry blossoms, no festival decorations, no Chinese architecture, no modern city, no artificial water park, no oversized human, no deformed animals, no text, no logo, no interface and no border.
